title: Docker-compatible API rejects tmpfs uid/gid ownership options
body:
Container creation through Podman's Docker-compatible API fails with this mount argument:

```text
--tmpfs /mnt/reploy-home:rw,noexec,nosuid,nodev,size=64m,mode=0700,uid=1000,gid=1000
```

Actual error:

```text
container create: unknown mount option "uid=1000": invalid mount option
```

Expected: accept explicit numeric ownership options, as [documented by Docker](https://docs.docker.com/engine/storage/tmpfs/).

Observed through Reploy with Docker CLI 29.8.1, API 1.44, and rootless Linux Podman built from upstream commit `5866b09c1f064775ab5e049c120ffe51c1cf1623`.

`pkg/util/mount_opts.go` rejects `uid` and `gid` in `processOptionsInternal`. Removing these options cannot guarantee the intended owner. Podman's native `U` option follows the container's startup user, which differs from the application user when an entrypoint starts as root and then drops privileges.
